meaning: Reference geometry affects the result used for acceptance

meaning: Contradictory evidence needs an explicit disposition
proposed_meaning: Transfer the preserved auxiliary result, raw-data provenance, reference/calibration chain, uncertainty and unresolved discrepancy to acceptance review; no dismissal solely for disagreement.
proposed_owner: Auxiliary measurement owner; acceptance review chair owns disposition
proposed_evidence: HG-03-D01 with causal explanation, retained contrary evidence and review

proposed_owner: Fixture configuration custodian; independent metrology lead
proposed_evidence: Released definition; calibration records; assembly history; HG-03-V01

meaning: Production-reference results inform the acceptance claim
